voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In June 2014, a family bought a large house in Westfield, New Jersey, for their five children.
Before they moved in, the first letter arrived. It was signed, the Watcher.
It called the children, quote, young blood. It described the house in detail.
Three more letters came. The writer was never identified.
The family never moved in. The house is still on the boulevard. The case is still open.
